notes.title: A NEW DLC FOR GUNSMITH SIMULATOR IS COMING – FABRYKA BRONI RADOM!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35193301/09968e12757e9436a07eb980889275220a8be810.png

Dear gunsmiths,

We are excited to announce the reveal of our latest DLC – Gunsmith Simulator – Fabryka Broni Radom! Together with top-tier specialists from Fabryka Broni, we have created this DLC to give you the opportunity to repair and upgrade guns from this legendary Polish firearms manufacturer, where tradition meets modernity.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499740/Gunsmith_Simulator__Fabryka_Broni_DLC/

What’s in store for you?
The DLC will feature four flagship guns from Fabryka Broni Radom, symbolizing the excellence of Polish firearms engineering:

 VIS Pistol – An icon of Polish engineering, recognized and respected worldwide.
 MSBS GROT Assault Rifle – A modern, modular firearm system designed for versatility and ergonomics.
 Beryl Assault Rifle – Reliable and precise, tested in the toughest conditions.
 Mini Beryl Compact Assault Rifle – Compact yet just as dependable as its bigger brother.

These four guns are the essence of this new DLC! In your workshop, you'll have the chance to repair, upgrade, and explore the history of these exceptional firearms.

But that’s not all!
Before the DLC is released, we will launch a free update that introduces two new guns for repair! The exact release date for the DLC has not yet been set, but we’ll share more details soon.

Stay tuned!
Make sure to add the  Fabryka Broni Radom DLC  to your Steam wishlist so you don’t miss the release and get notified when it’s ready.

We can’t wait to hear your thoughts, and we’re sure that the Fabryka Broni Radom DLC will bring you plenty of excitement!

[hr][/hr]
P.S. Check out our DLC👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3288480/Gunsmith_Simulator__Flint__Powder/

notes.title: FLINT & POWDER – NEW DLC COMING SOON!
notes.content:
Dear Gunsmiths,

We are excited to announce the long-awaited reveal of the first DLC for Gunsmith Simulator — Flint & Powder! After months of anticipation, the moment has come for you to travel back in time and explore the mysteries of the ancient masters of firearms. This is a DLC you won’t want to miss!

[previewyoutube=ObzGlQfeiGo;full][/previewyoutube]

In Flint & Powder, you will immerse yourself in the fascinating world of historical flintlock firearms from the black powder era. You will have the chance to repair, reconstruct, and test five unique models that played a key role in the history of firearms. Become true experts in the craft of ancient gunsmiths!

In this DLC, you will find:

 Spanish Miquelet Pistol – a classic Spanish pistol with a precise ignition mechanism.
 Flintlock Derringer – a compact yet deadly pocket pistol.
 Kozienice Rifle – a Polish firearm known for its impressive accuracy.
 Brown Bess – one of the most important muskets in British army history.
 Danish M-1772 Flintlock Dragoon Pistol – a durable pistol designed for Danish cavalry.


Prepare for a true journey back in time, discovering stories sealed in iron and wood! Though the exact release date will be announced soon, you can already add it to your Steam wishlist so you won’t miss any updates.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3288480/Gunsmith_Simulator__Flint__Powder/

See you at the workshop, Gunsmiths!
The Game Hunters Team

notes.title: New update: Makarov is here!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37121359/7a295a3e2b90b5597d63f453156dae8296daeb42.png

Hello, Gunsmiths!

We come to you with exciting news! In the latest update to Gunsmith Simulator: Prologue, a new weapon has been introduced - Makarov.

Makarov is a Russian semi-automatic pistol that uses 9x18mm Makarov ammunition. This compact pistol was first introduced in 1951 and has since gained popularity among the Russian armed forces and many other countries. Its simple design, reliability and unique features make it highly favored among firearm enthusiasts.

We’d also like to remind you that the Early Access version of the game will be released very soon, offering even more weapons and thrilling challenges. You'll experience the joy of being true gunsmiths, working in your own workshop. You'll have the opportunity to repair, restore former glory and modify various types of weapons, creating unique pieces that will catch the attention of every enthusiast.

Mark the date in your calendar - July 19th - and don't forget to add the game to your Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1101120/Gunsmith_Simulator/

See you in the workshop!

notes.title: Update of Gunsmith SImulator: Prologue. Fixed bugs!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37121359/5357f6d2ad8a95a4d1f63aece8d3eaaf5311c5dc.png

Hello, Gunsmiths!

We’ve prepared a brief summary of our work on fixing bugs in our game Gunsmith Simulator: Prologue since its release. Thanks to the intensive efforts of our developers, we’ve managed to fix a few bugs that appeared at this stage. Below is a list of the fixed bugs:

[olist]
 Fixes in text localization.
 Change preventing using a profile name that would break path for saving the game.
 Separate setting for enabling or disabling motion blur.
 Enabling VSync automatically disables frame rate target.
 Default frame rate target set to 60, more options for frame rate targets.
[/olist]
We’d also like to thank you for all the feedback you’ve provided us. Without your help, we wouldn’t have been able to introduce so many fixes in such a short time since the release!

We hope that these fixes will allow you to enjoy smoother gameplay and that no more bugs will appear!

GameHunters
